UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated player profile, Online PVP username, and cumulative career shootout statistics.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

username.description: Display username used in Online PVP matches and on the back of the shooter jersey.

usernameLower.description: Lowercase normalized username matching the reserved document ID.

bestScore.description: Highest score achieved in a single 60-second contest.

totalShotsMade.description: Cumulative shots made across all sessions.

totalShotsAttempted.description: Cumulative shots attempted across all sessions.

totalCareerScore.description: Cumulative points scored across all sessions.

allTimeBestStreak.description: Longest consecutive make streak across all sessions.

totalSwishes.description: Cumulative clean swishes tracked for historical swish percentage.

totalSwishTrackedAttempts.description: Cumulative shot attempts tracked alongside totalSwishes.

totalBestStreakSum.description: Cumulative sum of each completed contest's best streak.

streakTrackedContests.description: Total contests tracked with best-streak history.

pvpWins.description: Total Online PVP wins against opponents.

pvpLosses.description: Total Online PVP losses against opponents.

pvpDraws.description: Total Online PVP draws against opponents.

bestFastBreakMs.description: Fastest 5-rack Fast-Break time-attack completion in milliseconds (0 if unset).

bestFastBreakSplitsMs.description: Cumulative 5-rack split timestamps (ms) from the player's fastest Fast-Break run.

UsernameClaim.title: UsernameClaim
UsernameClaim.description: Unique username reservation mapping lowercase username to owner UID.

username.description: Display casing of the reserved username.

RivalryRecord.title: RivalryRecord
RivalryRecord.description: Head-to-head Online PVP match history against a specific opponent.

opponentName.description: Display name of the PVP opponent.

pointsFor.description: Cumulative points scored against this opponent.

pointsAgainst.description: Cumulative points conceded to this opponent.

lastScoreFor.description: Score in the most recent match against this opponent.

lastScoreAgainst.description: Opponent score in the most recent match.

lastResult.description: Outcome of the most recent match against this opponent.

currentStreak.description: Current head-to-head streak (positive for win streak, negative for loss streak).

lastPlayedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last completed match.

League.title: League
League.description: Online PVP competitive league metadata, roster UIDs, and invite code.

id.description: Unique league identifier matching document ID.

name.description: Display name of the PVP league.

description.description: Optional league tagline or rules summary.

isPublic.description: Whether the league is visible in the public directory.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the league creator.

memberUids.description: List of UIDs currently enrolled in the league.

maxMembers.description: Maximum allowed members in this league (up to 25).

LeagueMember.title: LeagueMember
LeagueMember.description: Per-member league standings and PVP shootout totals.

uid.description: Member Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

pointsFor.description: Cumulative points scored in league PVP matches.

pointsAgainst.description: Cumulative points conceded in league PVP matches.

leaguePoints.description: Standings points (3 per win, 1 per draw).

bestScore.description: Highest single-match score inside this league.

LeagueCodeClaim.title: LeagueCodeClaim
LeagueCodeClaim.description: Unique 6-character invite code lookup pointing to a league ID.

UserLeagueRef.title: UserLeagueRef
UserLeagueRef.description: Per-user membership index entry referencing a joined PVP league.

Friendship.title: Friendship
Friendship.description: Two-player friend request and accepted friendship pairing indexed by sorted UIDs.

pairId.description: Deterministic sorted pair identifier matching document ID (uidA_uidB).

memberUids.description: Sorted two-element array of participant Firebase Auth UIDs.

requesterUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who initiated the friend request.

recipientUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user receiving the friend request.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the friendship was last updated.

CourtRankingEntry.title: CourtRankingEntry
CourtRankingEntry.description: Public per-court leaderboard entry storing a signed-in shooter's best contest score, streak, and swishes on a specific court.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the shooter matching document ID.

courtId.description: Court identifier matching the parent courtRankings document ID.

username.description: Shooter display handle shown on the court leaderboard.

bestScore.description: Highest single-contest score achieved by this shooter on this court.

bestStreak.description: Longest consecutive make streak achieved on this court.

totalSwishes.description: Cumulative clean swishes recorded on this court.

contestsPlayed.description: Total completed contests on this court.

lastScore.description: Most recent completed contest score on this court.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this court ranking entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest contest submission on this court.

PvpGlobalRankingEntry.title: PvpGlobalRankingEntry
PvpGlobalRankingEntry.description: Global Online 1v1 PVP leaderboard entry storing a signed-in shooter's best PVP score across all courts and PVP match stats.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the shooter matching document ID.

username.description: Shooter display handle shown on the global PVP leaderboard.

bestScore.description: Highest single-match PVP score achieved across all courts.

bestCourtId.description: Court on which the player's highest PVP score was recorded.

bestStreak.description: Longest consecutive make streak achieved in PVP mode.

totalSwishes.description: Cumulative clean swishes recorded in PVP matches.

pvpMatchesPlayed.description: Total completed Online 1v1 PVP matches tracked on the leaderboard.

lastScore.description: Most recent completed Online 1v1 PVP score.

lastCourtId.description: Court used in the most recent Online 1v1 PVP match.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this global PVP ranking entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest PVP match submission.

/users/{userId}.description: Private owner-only user profile and career shootout stats.

/users/{userId}/rivalries/{opponentKey}.description: Private owner-only head-to-head PVP rivalry records.

/users/{userId}/leagues/{leagueId}.description: Private owner-only index of leagues the user belongs to.

/usernames/{usernameLower}.description: Unique username reservation registry for Online PVP.

/leagues/{leagueId}.description: Online PVP competitive leagues (public directory or member access).

/leagues/{leagueId}/members/{memberUid}.description: Standings and match statistics for each member inside a league.

/leagueCodes/{code}.description: Unique 6-character invite code lookup for joining leagues.

/friendships/{pairId}.description: Two-player friend requests and accepted friendships.

/courtRankings/{courtId}/entries/{userId.description: Per-court shooter leaderboard entries ranked by best contest score on that specific court.

/pvpGlobalRankings/{userId}.description: Worldwide Top 100 leaderboard tracking Online 1v1 PVP performances across all courts.
